verdict.rationale: gstack is distributed as a git-cloned skill pack that you install and run on your own machine. The evidence shows global and vendored installs, project-local setup, and a dev mode that reads skills straight from your checkout. It ships its own local headless Chromium daemon, stores learnings locally under ~/.gstack, and its telemetry can reportedly be opted out of. Missing for 10: explicit self-hosting or licensing documentation, evidence of running without third-party hosted AI agent backends (it rides on hosts like Claude Code and Codex), and independent hands-on corroboration of a fully local or offline deployment.
